name: Bank Islam Malaysia Berhad

source.title: Bank Islam quarterly report Q2 FY2026

oneLine: Malaysia's first Islamic bank, offering Shariah-compliant financing, deposits and investment accounts.
inPlainWords: Bank Islam provides Shariah-compliant home, personal and business financing, and takes deposits and investment-account money.
Instead of interest, depositors share in the profit the bank earns on financing.
Most of its customers are individuals, especially civil servants with salary-deducted financing.
It is growing sustainable and social finance as part of its strategy (Q B3).

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Retail Banking
segments.desc: Home and personal financing and deposits for individuals

segments.name: Institutional Banking
segments.desc: Financing and treasury for companies and government agencies

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q2 FY2026 report p.36).

aiImages.caption: Deposits: savers' money kept safe and paid a return
Interest and fees: what borrowers and customers pay the bank
Loans: money lent so homes, cars and businesses can grow
